title: Python Dictionaries
description: Dictionaries are used to store data values in key:value pairs.

challenges.title: Create Dict
challenges.exercise: Create a dictionary named 'car' with brand='Ford'. Print it.

challenges.title: Access Value
challenges.exercise: Print the value of the 'brand' key.

challenges.title: Change Value
challenges.exercise: Change 'brand' to 'BMW' and print the dict.

challenges.title: Add Item
challenges.exercise: Add color='red' to the car dict and print it.

challenges.title: Remove Item
challenges.exercise: Remove 'brand' using pop() and print it.
